description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three LLaMA-2 models—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—on the CoLeG-R benchmark, measured as a percentage, under varying degrees of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on progressively larger datasets (D₀, D₁, D₂). The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R (%) ranging from 0 to 85 with major tick marks every 10 units, while the horizontal axis lists the three model sizes. For each model, four bars show performance with SFT on D₀ (light blue with diagonal stripes), D₀+D₁ (light orange with horizontal stripes), D₀+D₁+D₂ (light purple with diagonal stripes), and D₀+D₁+D₂ (solid light pink). Performance generally increases with model size and with the addition of more training data: for example, LLaMA-2-7B scores approximately 67% with D₀, rising to ~83% with D₀+D₁+D₂; LLaMA-2-13B improves from ~70% to ~80%; and LLaMA-2-70B reaches ~81% with D₀ and ~83% with D₀+D₁+D₂. The legend in the lower right clarifies the color and pattern coding for each SFT condition, and the bars are grouped by model size, with no sorting by performance.
